# Chonkie 1.6.1 (patch release) 🔨


This patch release focuses on fixing import issues and updating dependencies


## What's Changed


- chore(deps): bump pyjwt from 2.10.1 to 2.12.0 by[@dependabot](https://github.com/dependabot) \[bot\] in[#521](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/521)
- chore(deps): bump orjson from 3.11.3 to 3.11.6 by[@dependabot](https://github.com/dependabot) \[bot\] in[#520](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/520)
- chore: fix imports by[@chonk-lain](https://github.com/chonk-lain) in[#525](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/525)
- chore: add httpx and update \[all\] by[@chonk-lain](https://github.com/chonk-lain) in[#526](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/526)
- chore: bump version by[@chonk-lain](https://github.com/chonk-lain) in[#527](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/527)
- chore(deps): bump authlib from 1.6.7 to 1.6.9 by[@dependabot](https://github.com/dependabot) \[bot\] in[#524](https://github.com/feyninc/chonkie/pull/524)
